ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a schematic diagram of the vertical natural belt spectrum of the south slope and north slope of a mountain; the vertical axis is elevation, and the highest part of the mountain body exceeds 5000 meters. The south slope side is marked with “lake”; at relatively high elevations, alpine natural belts such as alpine meadow and alpine shrub meadow are distributed. On the north slope side, from high to low, relatively arid natural belts such as mountain steppe, mountain desert steppe, and temperate desert appear, and there is also vertical differentiation such as a coniferous forest belt. Then reason: This combination, with the south side close to the alpine landscape of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau and the north side close to an arid desert landscape, conforms to the characteristics of the vertical belt spectrum of the Qilian Mountains. The Qilian Mountains are the boundary line between China’s first-level terrain step and second-level terrain step, so this mountain is the boundary line between the first and second steps.
